Title: Sue's Cozy Goat Farm
Short Description: Explore your surroundings, find goats, and bring them back to the barn before nightfall.  The goats may not follow you unless you offer them something.  Beware of bears.

Title: Mahjong Solitaire
Short Description: Mahjong Solitaire, the classic tile-matching puzzle game.

Title: Poker Solitaire
Short Description: The classic Poker card stacking solitaire game played with a standard pack of 52 playing cards.

Title: Penduloodle
Short Description: Create your own pendulum painting.  Penduloodle allows you to undertake physics-based art as a Newtonian dynamic simulation to generate intricate, swirling Spirographic patterns on a virtual canvas.

Title: Chemical Reaction Dynamics - Langevin Model
Short Description: A chemistry-physics simulation that allows one to explore the dynamic, random motion of reactant molecules transitioning to product molecules over an energy barrier.

Title: Virtual Titration Lab
Short Description: A virtual lab where you titrate an unknown weak acid solution with a strong base solution in order to determine the molarity and pKa of the weak acid.

Title: Organic Nomenclature
Short Description: Practice your ability to name organic compounds.  Master IUPAC naming conventions for organic chains up to 10 carbons, identifying the parent chain, function group, and substiuents for each compound.

Title: Mahjong Chem
Short Description: A mahjong-styled tile-matching game for introductory and AP Chemistry students.  Several board layouts are offered that challenge players to match polyatomic ion names with the appropriate formula, metric prefixes with the appropriate base-10 exponent, and element names with symbols.

Title: Kinetic Molecular Gas Simulation
Short Description: A chemistry-physics simulation whereby users can explore principles of kinetic molecular theory and better understand how the speeds and kinetic energy of particles are impacted by changes in temperature, particle mass, and volume.

Title: VSEPR
Short Description: Explore principles of VSEPR theory as you are challenged to identify the shapes of chemical compounds, as well as the number of bonding domains, lone pairs, bond angles, and hybridization.

Title: Atomic Orbitals - Quantum Mechanics Sandbox
Author(s): Ritika Mora and Gia Gia Vo
Short Description: Visualize and explore the underlying characteristics of atomic orbitals, including their shapes, quantum numbers, and spectral absorption and emission wavelengths for transitions between electronic energy states.

Title: Le Chatelier Principle
Short Description: Apply stresses to a chemical equilibrium to see if the reaction shifts toward products or reactants.  Investigate how changes in concentration, temperature, and pressure impact the reaction quotient and the position of equilibrium.

Title: Mandelbrot Renderer
Short Description: Graphically zoom in and explore the famous mathematical Mandelbrot set to reveal the infinite, repeating detail of this complex fractal structure.
